entries.source: A horrid mass of pustulent flesh, sinew, and bone; this creature seems to constantly be in pain. Two heads glare malevolently at you, an intruder in its domain.
entries.target: 一团由化脓的血肉、肌腱和骨头组成的恐怖混合体，这只生物似乎无时无刻不在承受痛苦。它的两个脑袋恶狠狠地瞪着你这个闯入其领地的不速之客。

entries.source: Those leather boots can make anybody as annoying as their former possessor, Draebor.
entries.target: 这双皮靴能让任何人都变得像它的前任主人小恶魔德瑞宝一样惹人厌烦。

entries.source: A malevolent skeleton archmage that has taken control of the Dreadfell since the Master's demise.
entries.target: 一位邪恶的骷髅大法师，自领主死后便掌控了恐惧王座。

entries.source:
What once must have been an enchantingly beautiful Higher woman now looks to be a ghost of utter despair. Her thin, elegant form ripples gently in the air, whilst her tattered robes seem oddly still. The ghost's face looks jittery and pained whilst her wild, glowing eyes move rapidly back and forth in their sockets.
Now and then she seems to see something and her jaw pulls back, her whole face splitting apart as she shrieks an unholy cry of pain and torment.
entries.target:
这位曾经想必美得摄人心魄的高等人类女子，如今看上去只是一只彻底绝望的幽灵。她瘦弱而优雅的身躯在空中轻轻荡漾，破烂的长袍却诡异地纹丝不动。她的脸上满是抽搐与痛苦，狂乱而发亮的眼睛在眼眶里飞快地来回转动。
她不时像是看到了什么，下颌随之向后扯开，整张脸仿佛裂成两半，发出一声充满痛苦与折磨的邪异尖啸。

entries.source: A letter written in a bold, commanding script
entries.target: 一封字迹遒劲、透着威严的信

entries.source: A hole small enough that only you can go through.
entries.target: 一个只有你能通过的小洞。

entries.source: You touch the dreamstone and it disappears. You feel better.
entries.target: 你触碰了梦境之石，它消失了。你感觉好多了。

entries.source: Do you have anything worth living for?
entries.target: 你有什么值得为之活下去的东西吗？

entries.source: Your wife has been turned into a giant, bloated form that towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the floor. The sight and the smell make you retch.
entries.target: 你的妻子变成了一只铁塔般的浮肿怪物。黏液和粘稠的液体从每个孔洞向外渗出，不断滴落在地板上。此情此景使你异常反胃。

entries.source:
The noxious fumes have invaded all your body, you suddenty fall into a deep slumber...
... you feel weak ...
... you feel unimportant ...
... you feel like ... food ...
You feel like running away!
entries.target:
有毒的气息渗入你的全身，你突然陷入沉眠之中…
…你感觉自己很虚弱…
…你感觉自己很渺小…
…你感觉自己…就像是猎物…
你感觉你必须赶紧逃跑！

entries.source:
As your mind-mouse enters the dream portal you suddenly wake up.
You feel good!
entries.target:
当梦中的老鼠进入了梦境传送门之时，你突然醒来。
你感觉神清气爽！

entries.source:
The noxious fumes have invaded all your body, you suddenty fall into a deep slumber...
... you feel you forgot something ...
... you feel lost ...
... you feel sad ...
You forgot your wife! Find her!
entries.target:
有毒的气息渗入你的全身，你突然陷入沉眠之中…
…你感觉自己忘了什么…
…你感觉自己处在迷失之中…
…你感觉自己很沮丧…
你忘了你的妻子！快找到她！

entries.source:
As you enter the dream portal you suddenly wake up.
You feel good!
entries.target:
当你进入了梦境传送门之时，你突然醒来。
你感觉神清气爽！

entries.source: %s has %d stat point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: %s有%d可用属性点。请按 P 键使用。

entries.source:
As you die in a dream you suddenly wake up.
Poisonous fumes take their toll on your body!
entries.target:
当你在梦中死去时，你突然醒来。
有毒的烟雾侵蚀着你的身体！

entries.source: A ripple in the void that somehow seems... alive, this creature stares at you with interest.
entries.target: 虚空中的一道涟漪，不知为何显得……有生命。这只生物饶有兴致地注视着你。

entries.source: The Eidolon Plane seems not to physically exist in the same way the normal world does. You cannot seem to drop anything here. %s comes back into your backpack.
entries.target: 艾德隆位面似乎并不像现实世界一样真实存在，你在这里似乎不能丢弃任何东西，%s 又回到了你的背包中。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#You are sent back to the material plane!

A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...
entries.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向西方，通向灼烧之痕——一个能带来死亡的活火山……

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal while it fades away and in the blink of an eye you set foot on hellish land, the heart of a volcano...
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了正在消逝的传送漩涡，转瞬间便踏上了地狱般的土地——一座火山的腹地……

entries.source: A Human warrior, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from him.
entries.target: 一位身披闪亮板甲的人类战士。力量从他身上散发出来。
智慧的乌克勒姆斯维奇

entries.source: It looks like a cross between a shark and a dragon, only nastier.
entries.target: 它看起来像是鲨鱼和龙的混合体，只是更加丑陋。
